headline: A 2017 law renames a Border Patrol checkpoint in Sarita, Texas, after Javier Vega, Jr.
what_it_does: This law gives a new name to a U.S. Border Patrol checkpoint on U.S. Highway 77 North in Sarita, Texas. The new name is the Javier Vega, Jr. Border Patrol Checkpoint. It honors Javier Vega, Jr., and does not change how the checkpoint operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 2, 2017.
